Maria (CS): quick dedicated pool check for AcmeCorp — sharing the last 7d snapshot. noticed a steady uptick in GPU hours and a couple of short saturation spikes. can folks skim and flag any concerns?

Kevin (Ops): saw it too. raw numbers?

Maria (CS): 7d totals: GPU hours 3,276 (↑22% w/w). avg saturation 78% (median), peak 96% at 2025-11-03T10:17Z. avg queue depth 12, p95 queue depth 43. weekly spend on dedicated nodes ≈ $12.4k (estimate from billing). error rate 0.6% — mostly OOMs during the high spike window.

Raj (PM): that p95 queue depth of 43 — is that user-facing latency, or queued background jobs? what's timing of the spikes?

Maria (CS): spikes line up with their nightly bulk-embed job and some interactive traffic overlap around 02:00–02:20 UTC and again a short peak around 10:15 UTC. the 10:15 one seems interactive (low token count, high QPS).

Sophia (ML): quick thought — the nightly job can be switched to a lower-precision variant (int8) and reduce memory/throughput pressure. i can run a quick eval to estimate GPU hour reduction.

Kevin (Ops): ops notes: autoscaling currently disabled for this pool (customer asked for stable capacity). we can enable scheduled autoscale bump for 01:50–02:30 UTC to cover batch window and a small burst window at 10:00–10:30. also will add an alert for p95 queue depth > 30.

Maria (CS): concrete recs i propose: 1) enable scheduled autoscale with +1 GPU during nightly batch; 2) deploy alert for p95 queue depth > 30; 3) run quantized variant for batch job (Sophia to validate); 4) temporary runbook to abort batch if saturation > 95% for >2m.

Raj (PM): agree. renewal conversation is in 6 weeks — if we stabilize avg saturation <85% and no recurring OOMs, renewal risk drops significantly. want to document these mitigations in the customer renewal playbook.

Kevin (Ops): putting the alert and scheduled autoscale on my board now. i can enable autoscale as a soft cap (allow burst but enforce max GPUs). will ping when changed.

Sophia (ML): i'll run a 1-hour eval on the batch job with int8 and post results by EOD. estimate: 25–35% GPU hour reduction but will validate quality.

deploy-bot: autoscale change request queued — run id 8a3f2b queued.

Kevin (Ops): applied scheduled bump for 01:50–02:30 UTC (+1 GPU), and alert created: monitors/CS-acmecorp-p95-queue-depth. added metric-based runbook entry. :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): thanks. i'll update the customer health doc and email AcmeCorp with the plan + ask if they'd prefer enabling autoscale or an outright additional reserved GPU.

Raj (PM): tagging renewal lead @Raj (PM) — we'll add a note: "Mitigations in progress: scheduled autoscale, alerting, quantization evaluation"

Sophia (ML): posted eval stub with commands for the batch job test. snippet:
```bash
# run small quantization test job
python run_embed_job.py --model rwd-embed-v1 --precision int8 --subset 1000
```

Maria (CS): follow-ups: 1) Sophia result EOD, 2) Kevin confirm no regressions from autoscale, 3) i'll draft the renewal note. any other blockers?

Kevin (Ops): none from infra. will monitor the 02:00 window tomorrow.

Sophia (ML): none — starting tests now. :rocket:

Maria (CS): great, thanks everyone. i'll close the loop after the test and tomorrow morning's spike window. :thumbsup:
